answer: Yes, we buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one, so bring your Virginia registration. At a North Carolina store, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station first. North Carolina also requires the registration to be current on the day of the sale, so plan to renew it before your appointment. The help center doesn't explain how to renew a Virginia registration after you've moved, so please contact a store for help with that; your Virginia plates should be removed and kept.
